4875-6797-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
4875-6797-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.

202-3966-7863--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
202-3966-7863--165.description:
Draw a card.
Human Torch triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Exquisite Blood triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Lich triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

1981-2292-2415-7192.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Grave Venerations and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Grave Venerations trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, scrying 1.
Repeat.

4-1170-1636-7524.easyPrerequisites: Rocket Volley must have valid targets.
4-1170-1636-7524.description:
Cast Rocket Volley using Hoarding Broodlord's convoke ability by tapping creatures you control.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Maelstrom Artisan.
When Maelstrom Artisan enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.

792-997-1580-4871.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Totentanz trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

567-4017-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
567-4017-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
The other Hero triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

296-3532-5078-7692.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
296-3532-5078-7692.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
The Thirteenth Doctor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1170-2642-4050-7490.description:
Cast a copy of the prepared spell by paying its mana cost.
When you cast that spell, Displacer Kitten and Dovescape trigger.
Resolve the Dovescape trigger, countering the prepared spell and creating a number of 1/1 flying Bird creature tokens equal to its mana value.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Elite Interceptor // Rejoinder, which enters prepared.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Bird token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat step 5 until you have enough mana to cast the prepared spell.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1115-3259-7262.easyPrerequisites: There are creature cards in your library.
1115-3259-7262.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1115-3259-7262.description:
Declare Raph & Mikey and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
Raph & Mikey triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature put onto the battlefield in step 2, and then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase until you have no creatures left in your library.
1115-3259-7262.notes: The number of combat phases you can get will be equal to the number of creature you control (excluding those listed in this combo) plus the number of creatures in your library plus 1.

2034-3490-4369-6847.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
2034-3490-4369-6847.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Weftstalker Ardent triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
The Red Terror triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Weftstalker Ardent triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Weftstalker Ardent triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 3.

967-2438-3809-6441-7087.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

1563-3490-6968-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
1563-3490-6968-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

5220-6537-6798-6900.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Tarpan.
When Tarpan dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Tarpan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Tarpan trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Cast Tarpan from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Gwenom.
Repeat.

323-1894-2173-5220.description:
Activate Bile Urchin by sacrificing it.
When Bile Urchin dies, Mortuary and Falkenrath Noble trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Bile Urchin from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Bile Urchin ability.
Cast Bile Urchin from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1789-5649-5929-6798.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters the battlefield, Lathliss triggers.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-2308-4699.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-2308-4699.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {C}{C}.
When the Fungus Beast dies, Overgrowth Elemental triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Repeat from step 2.

2034-2820-4679-4785.description:
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Angelic Renewal.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Yenna, adding {C}{C}.
When Yenna dies, both Angelic Renewals trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, choosing to sacrifice either Angelic Renewal and return Yenna from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.

193-3604-5034.description:
Cast Aminatou by paying {W}{U}{B}.
When Aminatou enters the battlefield, Cadric triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Cadric trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Aminatou.
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Sol Ring.
Activate the token Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking the nontoken Aminatou.
Repeat from step 2.
193-3604-5034.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can blink other permanent(s) instead. If those permanents are legendary, you can copy them via Cadric.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2292-2770-5434-5555.notablePrerequisites:
You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
You have enough mana to cast Donate.
2292-2770-5434-5555.description:
Cast Donate by paying its mana cost, giving control of Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat from step 2.

914-1251-3335.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-1251-3335.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least five Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{U}{U}{R}.
Cast Lady Sun by paying {1}{U}{U}.
Activate Lady Sun by tapping it, returning it and Dockside Extortionist from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
914-1251-3335.notes: If opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens.

1636-2085-5970-6219.notablePrerequisites:
Ritual Chamber is locked.
Marina and Kelpie Guide do not have summoning sickness.
1636-2085-5970-6219.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Ritual Chamber.
Ritual Chamber triggers, creating a 6/6 Demon creature token with flying.
When the Demon enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Ritual Chamber.
Activate Kelpie Guide by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

2608-3990-4499.notablePrerequisites: Incubation Druid does not have summoning sickness, and has at least one +1/+1 counter on it. You control a mana-producing land.
2608-3990-4499.description:
Activate Incubation Druid by tapping it, adding {3}.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Derevi.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Incubation Druid.
Repeat.

1636-4221-5996.easyPrerequisites: Tarmogoyf Nest does not have summoning sickness.
1636-4221-5996.notablePrerequisites: Creatures and/or lands you control can tap to produce at least {1}{G}.
1636-4221-5996.description:
Activate any number of creatures and/or lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{G}.
Activate the land with Tarmogoyf Nest attached by paying {1}{G} and tapping it, creating a Tarmogoyf creature token.
When the Tarmogoyf enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

2082-4050-4186.easyPrerequisites: Sadistic Glee attached to Scurry Oak.
2082-4050-4186.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature
2082-4050-4186.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing any other creature, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, Sadisitc Glee triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Repeat.

3086-3603-4605-4681.description:
Cast Cloudshift by paying {W}, blinking Lagrella.
When Lagrella enters the battlefield, it and Preston triggers.
Resolve the Lagrella trigger, exiling Karmic Guide until Lagrella leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Lagrella that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Put the nontoken Lagrella into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
If Lagrella is your commander, choose not to return it to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Lagrella leaves the battlefield, Karmic Guide is returned to the battlefield from exile.
Karmic Guide, Lagrella and Preston each trigger.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Karmic Guide that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Karmic Guide token enters the battlefield, it triggers, choosing to return nothing to the battlefield.
Resolve the Lagrella trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on the nontoken Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger from step 8, returning Lagrella from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2440-3517-4186.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Scurry Oak has a +1/+1 counter on it.
2440-3517-4186.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Tainted Observer and Mana Echoes triggers.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each creature that shares a creature type with the creature that entered the battlefield.
Resolve the Tainted Observer trigger, causing you to pay {2} to put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

765-1479-4288.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
765-1479-4288.description:
Play Guildless Commons.
When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, it, Sarinth Greatwurm, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Sarinth Greatwurm trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Guildless Commons from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, it and Sarinth Greatwurm trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

3562-4499.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {4}.
3562-4499.description:
Activate all mana producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Sky Hussar.
Sky Hussar enters the battlefield, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.

132-1283-2645.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Chromatic Orrery's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3}, untapping Myr Welder.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
132-1283-2645.notes: You can optionally exile Staff of Domination using Myr Welder, and then use the first ability of Staff of Domination to untap Myr Welder. Once you have enough mana, you can use Chromatic Orrery's second ability instead if you control a colored permanent.

262-2999-3957.notablePrerequisites:
Famished Paladin does not have summoning sickness.
Elemental Mastery attached to Famished Paladin.
262-2999-3957.description:
Tap Famished Paladin to create 3 1/1 creature tokens with haste.
The token ETBs, triggering Impassioned Orator three times, gaining you 1 life each time.
Famished Paladin triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat for infinite creature tokens.

uses.n: Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life

224-1993-3861.notablePrerequisites: You control fewer than nine lands.
224-1993-3861.description:
Activate Budoka Gardener by tapping it, putting Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Budoka Gardener.
Repeat.
